content: Baileys impersonates a WhatsApp companion device; using it for automation violates WhatsApp ToS and ban risk is real and unpredictable. GH issues #1869/#2075 report clusters of bans including accounts that ran 3+ years without incident, suggesting enforcement shifts over time; these are anecdotal, unlabelled by maintainers, and issue #1869 went stale without technical explanation. Warm-up advice is universal across vendor sources: week 1 manual human use only, week 2 ~10-20 automated msgs/day, then ~20% increases; connecting a brand-new SIM and immediately broadcasting is described as a guaranteed fast ban. Reply/receive ratio and identical-content repetition are cited as detection signals. The '1 in 5 accounts banned within a year' figure is vendor marketing with no methodology.
